semantics.kind: Pure combinational Moore transition and output logic, as explicitly requested; no storage, reset, initialization or cycle latency.
semantics.equations: next_state[0]=~in & (state[0]|state[2]); next_state[1]=in & (state[0]|state[1]|state[3]); next_state[2]=~in & (state[1]|state[3]); next_state[3]=in & state[2]; out=state[3]

numeric.widths: All scalar except 4-bit state and next_state
numeric.arithmetic: Only bitwise Boolean equations; no arithmetic or signed values

verification.oracle: Original transition table checked independently using explicit per-state expected values
verification.coverage: All eight legal state/input pairs in forward and reverse order, toggling inputs and states; output independent of in
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait 1 ns for combinational settling; original has no clock or timing waveform
verification.failure: Case inequality, fatal mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only on completion

specification_ambiguities.issue: Zero-hot, multi-hot and X/Z state or input behavior unspecified; original assumes one-hot state encoding
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use directly derived one-hot Boolean equations without illegal-state recovery; normative table verification limited to legal binary states and inputs
